evidence.mechanism: shot-02s: bottom two rows are bent from the base while the upper rows stay straight; by shot-08s the whole grid curls, and by shot-20s the bottom rows reopen first while the top row stays curled.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: 48 strips of 12-segment nested chains with pale skin, dark fibre lines and an ochre haze behind each; by shot-20s the grid scale drops for a pull-back. CSS-only, with no simulation.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: cream ground with rust and ochre strips and graphite bases, a clean palette; segment joints look stepped and blocky at full size, and the shot-08s curls repeat near-identical hooks.
evidence.distinctness: shot-08s: a grid of curled C-hooks in one tone with ochre haze; by shot-20s the top row stays curled while the lower rows open, a subject not seen in the anchor strips.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: grid framed with cream margins and the bend already started at the bottom; shot-20s: the open-to-closed gradient differs from the 2s frame, so the piece resolves.

pairwise_justification: No median archive exists yet, so there is no prior piece to compare head to head.

critique.change: Make the bend wave read as a front: at shot-08s give each strip its own curl amplitude and delay so a band of open and closed strips crosses the grid, instead of 48 identical hooks.
Show the skin-over-fibre split: draw the pale skin on one face and the dark fibre lines on the other at shot-02s, so the two-layer mechanism is visible as well as the bend.
Smooth the segment joints at shot-08s, where the 12 segments show stepped, blocky edges at full size; use finer segments or sub-pixel overlap so the curl reads as a continuous hinge.
